name: apiary-rebuild-v5
description: The Apiary rebuild's ACTION layer, switched off. READ THIS BEFORE READING THE ARM. A suit rebuild is a data-and-handler change, not a set of numbers, so NO OVERLAY CAN EXPRESS "the Apiary suit as it was" - the old suit printed the Hired Worker system on three cards and a crop waiver on its Farmstead, and neither is a knob. This arm therefore isolates the ONE piece of the rebuild an overlay can reach: A13 The Queen's Hive, A14 The Honeycomb Tower and A15 The Royal Apiary, the three Tier 3 ACTION cards. What it measures is what the action layer is worth, and above all what the COIN FAUCET is worth - A14 is the first repeatable one in the game (risk 2) and A15 hands out five cards for £10, and the pair are the only reason the market has ever had to exist. So read this cell for: market buys per game (was 0.1), coins minted by A14 per game, the coin-flood assertion, and total coins in play. Everything else is before-and-after against the committed reference run, not against this cell - the two conditions that DECIDE the rebuild (Apiary's mean card play rate up from 19.9%, and its win rate up from 20.7% toward the 37.5% even share) and every diagnostic: activations per Apiary turn, the round of a seat's first activation (risk 1, the cold start), ACTIVATIONS OF A FULL BUILDING - which matters more than the win rate, because if it is near zero the design's central claim is wrong and the suit needs a harvest valve after all - activations of foreign-crop buildings (risk 5), cards into an Apiary seat's barn (risk 4, against Dairy's 10.2 and Orchard's 25.7), A10 and A11 up from 5%, A13/A14/A15 up sharply from the Tier 3 baseline of about 2%, and Tier 3 firings per card built up from 0.63. GUARDRAILS THAT MUST NOT MOVE: reshuffles per played deck flat at 5 to 8 (A13 and A15 each take five deck tops in one action), clog as denial at 0.5% / 0.1% / 0.0% (A14 and A4 both push on it, and the dial if it moves is to stop a neighbour's Notice Board and Service being legal sow targets), the barn glut, visits per turn at or above 0.51, and the bonus-slot mix still at least 70% visit. RUN THE TIER 3 ARM AND THE TIER 1 REBUILD AS SEPARATE SWEEPS: the activation seam and the coin faucet fix different faults and will otherwise be credited to each other. Read the noise floor before believing any of it.
